# Ironwood Construction | Pro storefront listing
- Upload this folder to `dist/pre-made-templates/ironwood-construction-pro-theme/` and run `node scripts/build-template-catalog.mjs` locally or push to GitHub for Vercel to regenerate automatically.
- `index.html`: static, no-WordPress demo of the homepage look.
- `details.html`: plugin disclosure and included features.
- `template.json`: auto-catalog metadata.
- `preview.webp`: storefront screenshot.
- `ironwood-construction-pro-theme.zip`: installable WordPress theme archive (for private testing; do not activate public checkout until QA and terms completed).
- **Dependencies:** none for layout; see details.html / theme zip PLUGINS.md for functional booking requirements.
